metric_alignment.evidence: paper Section IV-C Eqs. 12-13 specifies exactly batch-size randomly sampled pairs and lambda_smooth=1; deterministic sampler is disclosed reconstruction

evolution_bridge.transition: encode P to Hp; tournament-select H1 and H2 under CDP plus NSGA-II; Hm=Hp+0.3*(H1-H2); inherit exactly one random dimension from Hm and all others from Hp; bounded polynomial mutation probability 1/64 and distribution index 20; decode; deduplicate; Gaussian-repair at most two conflicts or reinitialize if more; evaluate; CDP plus NSGA-II environmental selection
evolution_bridge.evidence: paper Section IV-D, Algorithm 2, Eqs. 14-16, and Section V; disclosed checkpoint and deterministic tie rules are in shared/contracts/taae_transformer_evolution_declared_reconstruction_contract.json
